subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should the Microsoft Teams attachment recovery path land as the broader automatic channel fix, a default-off group-chat option, or one combined implementation?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fallback default affects Graph call volume, permission expectations, diagnostics, and whether the earlier mention-only false-positive protection remains default behavior.

options.title: Sequence the two active fixes
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 as the channel top-level/thread-reply fix and handle https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 as a narrower default-off group-chat recovery after its scope review is resolved.

options.title: Require one combined PR
options.body: Ask contributors to reconcile channel URL construction, reply handling, and group-chat fallback into one msteams media PR before landing.

options.title: Prefer no new config surface
options.body: Use the automatic non-personal Graph fallback approach only if maintainers accept the extra Graph reads and diagnostics tradeoff for existing deployments.

recommendation.title: Sequence the two active fixes
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 as the channel top-level/thread-reply fix and handle https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 as a narrower default-off group-chat recovery after its scope review is resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest feature-history signal across the Teams plugin boundary and the remaining choice is a product/config fallback decision.
